label: Diagram 7.2
caption: Diagram 7.2 Uninsulated glazed screen separating protected shaft from lobby or corridor
description: This is a floor plan in two parts, a. With corridor and b. With lobby, with a legend at the right. Top left reads 'See paras 7.24 and 7.25'; the bottom green band titles it 'Diagram 7.2 Uninsulated glazed screen separating protected shaft from lobby or corridor'. In part a, a space labelled Corridor fills the left, and a hatched rectangle at top right is the Protected shaft; an Uninsulated glazed screen (minimum RE 30) with two doorset arcs lies between them. In part b, the same Uninsulated glazed screen (minimum RE 30) separates the outer space from a box labelled Protected lobby, which sits beneath the hatched Protected shaft; a doorset arc is shown in the screen and a doorset arc between the lobby and the shaft. The legend defines the line symbols: a thick black line as External wall; a green line as 'Fire resistance of protected shaft to be a maximum of REI 60'; a grey line as 'Fire resistance of construction to be a minimum of REI 30'; a thin line with short ticks as 'Fire resistance of glazed screen to be a minimum of RE 30'; and a green arc as 'Fire doorsets that are a minimum of E 30 S'.
